column3: With respect to the 205 East 42nd Street Mortgage Loan (9.0%), the Mortgaged Property is structured as a “leasehold condominium” for the not-for-profit occupants of such leasehold condominium to qualify for an exemption from real estate property taxes under Section 420-a of the New York Real Property Tax Law (“Section 420-a Exemption”). Under the Section 420-a Exemption law, not-for-profit entities may qualify for an exemption from real estate property taxes, provided that such not-for-profit owns the real estate that it occupies and uses such property for not-for-profit purposes.
